help.gitlab.supportedTitle: Supported in Heidrun Code for GitLab
help.gitlab.supported: Use author:, assignee:, milestone:, label: (one label per filter), no:label, no:assignee, no:milestone, is:open or is:closed. Put - before author:, assignee:, milestone: or label: to exclude a value. @me means your signed-in GitLab account. Plain words and AND are also supported.
help.gitlab.reviews: For merge requests, is:merged and review-requested:@me are also supported.
help.gitlab.limits: Heidrun Code translates these expressions into GitLab filters. The full GitHub search language does not work here. Unsupported expressions show an error: mentions:, involves:, OR, NOT, parentheses, commas in labels, sort:, date filters, quoted free phrases and excluded plain words.
